correctness.rationale: Condition on other Bernoulli variables gives one-site deviation bound. At epsilon=1/k, any two nonextreme i/k sites in one window have maximal point-mass below 1-1/k for k>=3, forcing marks to be distance>=w and deterministic GC labels to be w-periodic with m ones. Exact bin weights (i+1)(k-i+1) give a weighted hard-core mark polynomial and characteristic equation lambda^w=lambda^(w-1)+2k/(k+1). For epsilon<1/(w+1), nearest-label rigidity and window union bounds sandwich the general capacity between W(floor(k epsilon/w)) and W(floor(k epsilon)), proving the high-resolution exponent. Independently recomputed 20 exact small first-threshold word counts.
residual_risks: Capacity is infinite-blocklength with fixed k first; n finite check not proof of all w,k; no whole-strand joint guarantee.
